messages:
Ryan (AE): Quick sync — Acme Fin wants a 6-week pilot to validate invoice summarization + contract QA. Need to lock success metrics (latency/cost/quality) and the eval plan. Who can own the eval set and rubrics?
Kate (SE): I can own evals. Two quick Qs: expected qps and token shapes? Also need to know if they want Hosted vs Dedicated for the pilot.
Arjun (SE): For latency we should clarify percentile targets (p50/p95/p99). Also suggest acceptance thresholds for hallucination/NER. Proposed: F1 >= 0.85 and hallucination rate < 3% on sample.
Ryan (AE): Customer requested p95 <= 350ms for 256-token requests. Cost target: <= $0.50 / 1k tokens during pilot. Timeline: infra kick next Tue, data delivery Wed.
Ben (Eng-Oncall): Eng note: we'll enable prefix cache + KV cache warmup. With guac-13b-q4 on Dedicated GPUs, p95 ~280ms at 1 qps/replica. If they expect bursts we need autoscale+burst config. I'll own infra runbook.
Priya (Product): For acceptance: 500 labeled examples + blind review of 200 outputs by SMEs. Pass if accuracy >= 88% and avg human rating >= 4/5. Include edge-case prompts in eval.
Nora (CSM): I'll coordinate SME reviewers and the rubric. I'll add an acceptance sign-off gate to the POC doc.
Ryan (AE): Pricing ask: Acme asked for a 30% pilot discount for 6 weeks. Finance — is that doable?
Matt (Finance): We can offer credits as the pilot mechanic. Standard pilot discount is 20%; 30% needs RevOps approval. I'll follow up via DM.
security_bot: SECURITY CHECK: Acme requires completed security questionnaire v3, SOC2 appendix, encryption at rest, and customer-managed KMS for Private deploys. Please attach questionnaire.
Arjun (SE): I'll start the questionnaire. If they require Private, we can propose Dedicated in their AWS account to meet KMS requirements. Need their network diagram and egress rules.
Ryan (AE): Action items: Kate -> eval plan by Fri; Ben -> infra runbook and perf test by Wed; Priya -> acceptance thresholds doc by Thu; Nora -> SME roster by next Mon; Matt -> confirm pilot credit by EOD. I'll share contact + data link now: https://acme.box.com/s/abcd
Kate (SE): Ack. Starting eval primer. If we pin guac-13b-q4 8-bit quant, will that meet cost/latency?
Ben (Eng-Oncall): Likely yes, but will validate. I'll run perf tests with representative tokens this week and post results. Example command: 
``` 
perf run --model guac-13b-q4 --seq 256 --qps 1 --duration 600
```
Ben (Eng-Oncall): Expected p95 ~280-320ms depending on NVLink and batch behavior.
Ryan (AE): Also add cost acceptance: mean cost per 1k tokens <= $0.45 across the eval set. Put that in acceptance doc.
Priya (Product): Agreed. Add fallback policy: if primary model fails threshold, route to smaller model with higher recall but adjusted cost profile; document gating logic.
Arjun (SE): Customer flagged a blocker: their proxy requires cert pinning for outbound TLS. Security team — can we support cert pinning / mTLS for Dedicated?
security_bot: Noted. Assigning to @Emma (Security) to confirm.
Emma (Security): We can support cert pinning for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we can explore mTLS options but need their proxy config. Send me the proxy details.
Ryan (AE): Great. I'll gather proxy config in the bundle. Final: 15-min call tomorrow 9am PT with Acme + our team to finalize scope. Please RSVP. :calendar:
Kate (SE): RSVP.
Nora (CSM): RSVP.
Arjun (SE): RSVP.
Ben (Eng-Oncall): I'll join first 15.
Matt (Finance): I'll join first 5 for pricing.
security_bot: Meeting invite created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz
Ryan (AE): Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after the call and update the POC doc with acceptance criteria and runbooks.
